read: stamps +0x940/+0x944, watermarks, CL consumer, event ring, 0x130, 0x12b0/0x12b8, 0x12c0/0x12c8
tells: stamps 1 = done. A bank-0 fault with the address near 0x201000 or 0x200000 = the PDS/stream address convention is wrong (use J1d)

change: only if J1 stalls without a fault: W+0x224/+0x234/+0x244 = 0x00a00004
only if J1 faults at the PDS address: put a HALT at the PDS heap base and use code/data offset 0 (relative to the exec base)

boot: Orchard's A9 driver runs every compute job with this terminate stream and HALT: its kernel maps the data page into every VM and Mesa names it in each job. An empty (no-kernel) job submitted on its own is not shown in the public code; their real jobs carry a kernel in front of the same terminate
